description: This file defines a common interface 'WithDittoHeaders' for classes that have associated 'DittoHeaders'. It provides methods to retrieve and set 'DittoHeaders'.

classes.name: WithDittoHeaders
classes.description: A generic interface for objects that have associated DittoHeaders, enabling retrieval and setting of headers.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with this object.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for this object and returns a new instance.
